items.title: ZDI-CAN-28071: Adobe
items.description: A CVSS score 7.8 AV:L/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H severity vulnerability discovered by 'Michael DePlante (@izobashi) of Trend Zero Day Initiative' was reported to the affected vendor on: 2025-09-04, 0 days ago.
